main.description: Remove a post from the community it was submitted to, with that community's authority. The caller must be a moderator of the post's community, which this instance must host, or an instance admin; an admin's removal is recorded as an admin acting for the community. The instance writes one commit to the community's repo that deletes the community's acceptance of the post and writes its social.coves.community.removal record, and applies the removal to its index before responding. The actor is the authenticated account, never a request field. Removals are rate limited per moderator and per community; instance admins are exempt.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; sign in before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is neither a moderator of the post's community nor an instance admin, or the community is not hosted here or is removed; do not retry.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request is incomplete or malformed: subject is not a record AT-URI, code is not a removal code, reason is too long, expectedVersion is negative or idempotencyKey is empty or too long; correct it before retrying.

errors.name: PostNotFound
errors.description: The post is not indexed in a community; do not retry.

errors.name: StateConflict
errors.description: expectedVersion is not the post's current community version, or the indexed stand records are behind the community's repo; refetch getCommunityState for the post before retrying.

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.description: The same key was reused with a different request; do not retry with that key.

errors.name: RateLimitExceeded
errors.description: The caller or the community has removed too many posts in the last hour; retry later.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service or the community's repo is temporarily unavailable; retry later with the same idempotency key.

input.description: Request to remove a post from its community

subject.description: AT-URI of the post to remove

code.description: Machine-readable reason for the removal, written to the removal record as is. The instance accepts only the known values.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation shown to the author and in the moderation log

expectedVersion.description: The post's community version (getCommunityState with the post AT-URI as subject) the caller expects

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque key that makes a retry of the same request return its first result; scoped to the caller and the community

output.description: The community decision on the post, applied before the response returns

uri.description: AT-URI of the record that now stands in the community's repo: the removal for removePost, the acceptance for restorePost

version.description: The post's community version after the action

actionId.description: ID of the moderation action logged for the change; absent when the decision was already in place

alreadyApplied.description: True when the decision was already in place, so nothing was written and no action was logged
